_sourcing_notes: Per-slot equipped item (name + real Wowhead icon + notable stat highlight) for each spec's level-20 BIS loadout, captured 2026-09-26 from foreverchanges.pro/fr/bis/<class>[/<spec>]'s own 'Personnage' equipped-gear panel -- the exact item feeding that page's own stat totals, which is also what bis_level20_stats.json's aggregate numbers are computed from. Icons resolved to the canonical Wowhead icon CDN (wow.zamimg.com), already used elsewhere on this site. Several specs share one list where foreverchanges.pro (and Icy Veins, independently) found their BIS gear is identical -- see bis_level20_stats.json's own per-spec notes for which. For full alternatives per slot (2nd/3rd choice, drop sources, quest chains), link to the matching foreverchanges.pro page -- not duplicated here.
